step1_analysis.description: Equivalent circuit model of a CMOS transmit-receive (T/R) switch in the ON state, capturing the channel resistance and the substrate parasitic network (source/drain-to-bulk capacitances and substrate resistances).

paper_reference.title: Integrated CMOS Transmit–Receive Switch Using LC-Tuned Substrate Bias for 2.4-GHz and 5.2-GHz Applications

insertion_loss_2_4GHz.description: Insertion loss of the switch at 2.4 GHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between 50-ohm source, Ron (~3 ohms), and 50-ohm load, plus substrate parasitic losses.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A properly sized NMOS switch in SKY130 can achieve ~3 ohms Ron, yielding ~1.5 dB insertion loss.

insertion_loss_5_2GHz.description: Insertion loss of the switch at 5.2 GHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to 2.4 GHz but with increased signal leakage through Cdb/Csb to the substrate.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher frequencies lead to more substrate loss, slightly degrading the insertion loss compared to 2.4 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Requires nonlinear transistor model; not measurable with this linear passive equivalent circuit.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 thick-oxide devices can handle high power, but this specific netlist is linear.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the insertion loss of the switch equivalent circuit at 2.4 GHz and 5.2 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* T/R Switch Equivalent Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Component values for the equivalent circuit
.param Rrx_val=50
.param rdsM1_val=3
.param CsbM1_val=0.5p
.param CdbM1_val=0.5p
.param Rtx1_val=200
.param RsubM1_val=200

* AC Source (2V peak to get 0dB at matched load)
Vac PA_Tx_src GND dc 0 ac 2
Rsrc PA_Tx_src PA_Tx 50

* DUT (Values appended to the provided netlist topology)
Rrx BPF_Ant GND {Rrx_val}
rdsM1 BPF_Ant PA_Tx {rdsM1_val}
CsbM1 BPF_Ant N0 {CsbM1_val}
CdbM1 PA_Tx N0 {CdbM1_val}
Rtx1 N0 GND {Rtx1_val}
RsubM1 N0 GND {RsubM1_val}

.control
ac dec 100 100Meg 10G
let IL_dB = vdb(BPF_Ant)
meas ac IL_2_4G find IL_dB at=2.4G
meas ac IL_5_2G find IL_dB at=5.2G
print IL_2_4G IL_5_2G
quit
.endc
.end
